title: Add evidence-bound implementation knowledge projection
outOfScope: Knowledge Query Interface implementation; it is the serial WI-2 consumer of this projection.
Semantic search, embeddings, LLM relevance ranking, current-code semantic validation, or customer-answer generation.
Backfilling missing historical Implementation Approach or Design Reason facts by inference.
Changes to external adopter CI, GitHub settings, branch protection, hosted providers, or production systems.
Changing the authoritative Contract, Summary, Evidence, or Outcome model into a new fact source.
rawUserRequest: Implementation Knowledge Projection: 在 Work Item Close 时，将已有 Summary/Outcome 中的实现知识压缩为可检索 projection，不成为新的事实源；生成 .ai/knowledge/work-items/<id>.json 和 .ai/knowledge/index.json，保留 unknown/partial，绑定 Summary/Outcome digest，stale 时 fail-closed，并纳入 adopter installer parity。

authorityEvidence.source: user explicitly requested the two-capability implementation and said to begin the corresponding work

declaredIntent.summary: Make implementation knowledge an evidence-bound, rebuildable projection with verified/partial/unknown states and fresh-adopter parity.

requestedOperation.reason: This changes repository runtime, schemas, installer delivery, generated knowledge artifacts, tests, and documentation.

sources.reason: User-provided requirements for the two capabilities, record fields, status model, fail-closed rules, lifecycle, and adopter parity.
Existing Summary/Outcome Implementation Approach projection and applicability behavior.
Existing machine-readable Outcome contract that remains authoritative.
Existing installer delivery catalog and adopter-facing surface.
Existing capability truth and installed parity manifest.

riskAssessment.reason: A projection that overclaims verified knowledge or is missing from adopter installation would damage trust; the authoritative evidence chain must remain unchanged and all generated artifacts must be rebuildable.

reasons: The Work Item changes evidence-bound knowledge output, schemas, installer catalog, and adopter parity.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized implementation of the two requested capabilities; high-risk evidence and installer boundaries remain enforced by the Contract and verification gates.

preReviewWarnings: Verified Knowledge Record claims must be derived from existing Summary/Outcome evidence and must fail closed on missing, stale, or mismatched evidence.
Legacy Work Items must remain partial/unknown; no inferred historical Implementation Approach may be written.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A code Work Item with evidence-bound implementationApproach produces .ai/knowledge/work-items/<work-item-id>.json with implementation, designDecisions, effects, evidence, mergedCommit, generatedFrom.summaryDigest, generatedFrom.outcomeDigest, and knowledgeState.
The projection reads existing Contract, Summary, Outcome, and evidence only; missing Implementation Approach or Design Reason remains unknown/partial and is never inferred.

Verified projection claims are emitted only when evidence paths exist, evidence digests are current when declared, Work Item identity matches, and Summary/Outcome projections agree; otherwise the record is partial/unknown and the checker fails closed.

The deterministic .ai/knowledge/index.json can be rebuilt from work-item records and contains only lightweight workItemId/title/topics/components/state fields plus record path, with stable ordering and no semantic-search data.
The projection records source digests and the checker detects stale Summary/Outcome sources or missing record files without rewriting authoritative archives.

The projection command and schemas are delivered through the installer catalog, adopter capability manifest, Make targets, and fresh-adopter parity tests; the installed runtime can generate/check the same record and index.
Unit, negative, schema, legacy-partial, rebuild, stale-digest, and installed-parity tests pass, and the projection documentation states the immutable-authority and fail-closed boundaries.
The Work Item produces a direct green Outcome only after all declared local governance checks and project tests pass; no Query Interface or natural-language answer generation is included.
guidelines: Knowledge Record is a rebuildable projection; Contract, Summary, Evidence, and Outcome remain authoritative.
Do not infer missing historical Implementation Approach, Design Reason, current validity, or supersession relationships.
Do not add semantic search, embeddings, LLM ranking, or customer-answer generation to the Core.
Every verified projection claim must retain repository-relative evidence and fail closed when the evidence is missing, stale, or mismatched.
Any adopter-facing runtime/schema/Make capability must be present in the installer catalog and proven by a fresh-adopter parity test.

intent.problem: The repository records what changed and has evidence-bound Implementation Approach in Summary/Outcome, but it cannot yet produce a small rebuildable knowledge projection that an external Agent can retrieve without parsing the entire archive. Historical absence must remain visible, and adopter installations must receive the same capability.
constraints: The projection is not a new fact source; it must be derived from existing Contract, Summary, Evidence, Outcome, and Git merge identity.
Unknown/partial legacy states must be preserved without AI backfill or current-code semantic validation.
The first version supports deterministic structured artifacts only; Query Interface and natural-language answers are a separate serial WI.
Installed adopter capability must be verified from a fresh adopter fixture, not inferred from template files or catalog declarations alone.
intent.rationale: A bounded projection gives external Agents a trustworthy retrieval surface while preserving the existing evidence chain and preventing self-declared or stale implementation knowledge from being presented as verified.
